distinctions.world_state_vs_cognitive_state: Current World is a candidate representation of referenced world/context inputs; Cognitive State is Luna's candidate epistemic, attentional, hypothesis, uncertainty, and conflict state.
distinctions.evidence_vs_hypothesis: Evidence supports or contests a hypothesis candidate; neither is automatically fact.
distinctions.provider_confidence_vs_cognitive_confide: Provider confidence remains provider metadata; Cognitive State Formation may retain a separate candidate confidence representation.
distinctions.attention_priority_vs_truth_probability: Attention priority expresses candidate relevance/urgency, not truth likelihood.
distinctions.hypothesis_vs_fact: Hypotheses remain revisable, multi-hypothesis candidates with unknown and conflict references.

existing_behavior: CognitiveStateFormationEngineV1 emits candidate-only attention, hypotheses, competition, CurrentWorld, vector, and causal handoff outputs with no source mutation or single-truth collapse.
b2_boundary: Consume B1 CurrentWorld as read-only evidence-bound candidate input; do not make Cognitive State a second Current World store.
